Scam app. This company is a complete scam. They advertise fake, impossibly low airfares to trick U.S. customers into booking. Once you enter your personal and credit card details, they call to say the ticket is “no longer available” and then try to charge you three times the original price.

They are collecting personal data of U.S. residents including full name, date of birth, address, and credit card information under false pretenses. Immediately after booking, you’ll start seeing unauthorized credit card charges or alerts.

These scamsters are sitting in India and using platforms like Wego to prey on unsuspecting travelers. Wego is directly enabling this fraud by giving them visibility and legitimacy on their site.

This is criminal activity plain and simple. They must be reported, shut down, and prosecuted for identity theft and online fraud. U.S. residents should never provide any information or payment to this fraudulent operator.

Wego must immediately remove this scam company from its listings and take responsibility for facilitating these crimes.

Won’t give me a refund for my ticket. I purchased a ticket on June 9th for a flight from Damascus to Los Angeles scheduled to depart on June 18th. On June 17th, I contacted wego after Qatar airways canceled my ticket due to the conflict between Iran and Israel. I was told that it would take 3 days to receive a confirmation email and 15 20 days for the refund to be processed.

After a week without receiving any confirmation, I called back and was told they would simply refund me within 20 days. I also reached out to them via WhatsApp and received the same response, they kept saying the refund would be issued in 20 days.

It has now been 17 days, and when I called again today, I was told the same thing: I would receive the refund in 15 20 days. I requested a written email confirming the refund for documentation purposes, but the representative told me the call was being recorded. I responded that the recording is for their records, not mine, but she continued repeating the same message about the 15 20 day refund timeframe.

At this point, I’m not sure what else I can do. I’ve called three times and contacted them on WhatsApp, but I’m still being told the same thing with no written confirmation.
